lines.x: Paris-listed smart label provider VusionGroup launched a takeover bid for Swedish electronic shelf-label maker Pricer with a premium of nearly 30%.
Shares in Swedish sensor developer JonDeTech jumped up to 25% on Tuesday following the announcement of a commercial partnership agreement with an international smart health ring manufacturer.
Financial markets are pricing in three to four Riksbank rate hikes next year, exceeding economist forecasts.
Nordic Compass and Nasdaq proposed an integrated stock exchange market to attract billions in capital, though institutional pension funds expressed hesitation.
